versions.content: If development error detection is enabled and any instance calls any Dem API, excluding Dem_SetEventStatus , Dem_ResetEventDebounceSta- tus , Dem_GetVersionInfo and Dem_MainFunction , after Dem_Shutdown has been called, the Dem module shall set the error code DEM_E_UNINIT until Dem_Init is called again.
